title: Payback is Coming
paragraphs: §Encouragement in Persecution

What's up, guys? It's Paul, Silas, and Timothy here, giving a shout-out to our crew in Thessalonica. We're repping God the Father and our main man, Jesus Christ. He's the one who hooks you up with everything you need and helps you grow into who you're meant to be.

Seriously, we can't stop thanking God for you guys. It's not just 'cause we're nice; we actually have to. Your faith is blowing up, and the way you look out for each other is awesome. We're totally bragging about you to everyone. You're holding it down and staying strong even when things get rough and life throws you curveballs. We're telling all the other churches how legit you are.

All the tough stuff you're going through? It's actually a good sign. It shows God's getting you ready for his kingdom. Yeah, you're taking some hits now, but payback is coming. When the boss, Jesus, rolls up from heaven with his squad of powerful angels, it's going to be lit. He's coming to settle the score with everyone who gave you a hard time. For all the people who ghosted God and ignored his message, it's the end. They'll be permanently kicked out from the awesome presence of the Lord and his incredible power. But for us, his followers, it's the moment we've all been waiting for. He's going to get a massive hero's welcome from everyone who believed, and that includes you, because you trusted what we told you.

So, knowing this epic day is right around the corner, we're always praying for you. We're asking God to make you worthy of his call, to strengthen all your good intentions and faithful actions with his energy so your lives make a real impact. The goal is for your life to bring honor to Jesus, and in return, he'll honor you. It's all thanks to the free gift of grace from our God and the Lord, Jesus Christ.

title: The Final Boss
paragraphs: §The Day of the Lord

Alright guys, listen up, for real. Chill out, and don't let anyone rattle you with claims that Jesus already came back. I know some people are spreading false rumors or a phony letter that looks like it's from me, saying you missed the whole thing. Don't fall for that garbage.

Before the real deal goes down, a couple of things have to happen first. First, a bunch of people are gonna totally ghost God. It's gonna be a massive falling away. Then, the ultimate enemy shows up—this guy who's basically Satan's right-hand man. He's gonna go on a rampage, dissing every other god and trashing their temples. Once he's cleared the field, he's gonna walk into God's own Temple, sit on the throne, and be like, "I'm God now." Seriously, have you guys already forgotten I told you all this? C'mon!

Remember how I said something is holding the ultimate enemy back for now? Yeah, that's still happening. But the evil vibes are already out there, working low-key. Soon, though, the thing holding him back will be gone, and this guy will be unleashed. But don't even sweat it. The Master, Jesus, will show up right when he does and totally own him. Jesus appears, and poof! That loser is toast.

The ultimate enemy will roll in with a ton of fake power, pulling off all these bogus miracles and signs. It's all a big show, a scam to trick people who don't want to hear the truth that could save them. And since they're so into all that evil stuff, God's just gonna let them have it. They wanted a world of lies, so that's what they'll get. They'll be stuck in their own fake reality.

But you guys? We're always thanking God for you. You're so loved by God, and He picked you out as His from the very beginning. He picked you to be saved because you kept it real and believed the truth. He invited you into this awesome life through the message we shared, so you could get in on the glory of our Master, Jesus Christ.

So, stand strong, my guys. Keep your feet on the ground and your heads held high. Hold on tight to everything we taught you, whether we said it to your face or wrote it in a letter. I pray that Jesus himself and God our Father, who loves you like crazy and has given you non-stop help and confidence, will fire you up, make your work awesome, and give you the right words to say.

title: Don't Be a Freeloader
paragraphs: §Warning Against Laziness

Alright, one last thing, my guys. Keep us in your thoughts, and pray that God's message goes viral, just like it did with you guys. Also, pray that we can dodge all the haters and troublemakers out there. It turns out, not everyone who says they're on the team is for real. But God is the ultimate authority; He's got our back and will keep you safe from the negativity.

We have total faith in you because you're with the Lord. We know you're already doing all the stuff we talked about, and you're gonna keep crushing it. We hope the big guy upstairs keeps guiding you to be more loving and tough, just like Christ was.

Now, here's a direct order from our Lord, Jesus Christ: you gotta ghost anyone in the squad who's being lazy and not pulling their weight like we showed you. Don't let them just freeload off everyone else. We set the example, right? We weren't just chilling and expecting you to take care of us. Nah, we worked our butts off, grinding day and night so we wouldn't be a burden to any of you. It wasn't because we couldn't have asked for your help—we had the right to. We just wanted to show you what the hustle looks like, hoping you'd catch on.

Remember the golden rule we had? "If you don't work, you don't eat." Simple. But now we're hearing that some of you are just being lazy bums, mooching off the hard work of others. That's not cool. We're telling those people to get a job, no excuses, and start paying their own way. For the rest of you, don't get tired of doing the right thing.
And you guys — don't burn out doing the right thing. Keep going and keep doing good.

If anyone ignores what we're saying in this letter, you need to call them out. Don't hang out with them or support their freeloading. Maybe that'll make them realize they're messing up. But don't treat them like an enemy. Just have a real talk with them, like a bro helping another bro out.
May the Lord of peace himself give you peace all the time, in every way. May the Lord be with you all.
I, Paul, am signing this off with my own hand. I do this in all my letters so you know it's legit.
The amazing grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you!
